name: The tread-navigator: an actor that shapes its future by configuring its gait rather than observing it. It is a closed tread whose ground-contact point is the present, whose rear arc is the past and whose forward arc is the future, so the future feet are its own past feet recirculated. Navigation is placing the future footfalls so the closed world-line is carried into a chosen reachable lane, where lanes are homotopy classes and the arm is the committed direction. A single move reaches only adjacent lanes; a braided order-dependent sequence reaches lanes no single move can, the reached direction being the Lie bracket of the controls, as in parallel parking. By Chow-Rashevskii the reachable set is the whole connected component when the gait and its braids span every direction. The mechanism is the promotion of winding from Abelian to non-Abelian braid, and it lives in the actor that closes the Dual-Link (mu after delta equals identity) by splitting the present into past and future arcs and fusing them back into the same present. Reachability is bounded to the connected component; other agents' treads remain B from outside.

VINIT.justification: The state before the tread is established or the first footfall is placed.

TANCH.justification: The limit of reachability defined by the span of the gait and its braids.

AFWD.justification: The projection of the tread into the future footfall positions.

AREV.justification: The recirculation of past footfalls back into the system.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of footfalls to form a continuous movement.

IMSCRIB.justification: The present moment where the tread recognizes its own position on the manifold.

FSPLIT.justification: The present moment splitting into a forward arc of potential and a rear arc of history.

FFUSE.justification: The reunification of the past and future arcs into the singular identity of the navigator.

EVALT.justification: Successful navigation into the intended homotopy class.

EVALF.justification: Failure to maintain the intended world-line or falling into an adjacent lane.

ENGAGR.justification: The state of other navigators which remain unresolved and simultaneous from the outside.

IFIX.justification: The irreversible fixation of a lane choice once the braid is completed.

phase_3.void_description: The navigator before the first step is taken

phase_3.both_description: Superposition of multiple potential braids before fixation

steps.domain_action: The navigator exists in a state of rest before the tread cycle begins
The navigator identifies its current ground-contact point as the present
The present splits into the forward arc of future steps and the rear arc of past steps
The forward arc projects toward the next footfall in the sequence
The navigator configures the gait by chaining specific footfall placements
The specific gait configuration is fixed as a committed direction
The gait successfully aligns with the target homotopy class
The rear arc recirculates the previous footfalls to maintain the closed loop
Any deviation in the rear arc is monitored to prevent lane loss
The forward and rear arcs reconstitute the navigator at the new present moment
A braided sequence of moves is initiated to reach non-adjacent lanes
The braid splits the trajectory into non-Abelian components
The navigator holds multiple lane possibilities in the Lie bracket
The braid resolves into a single reached direction
The navigator recognizes its new position on the manifold
The world-line closes within the connected component boundary
